description: This file defines a set of React functional components for a UI card element, including components for header, title, description, action area, content, and footer, all designed to be used as building blocks for rendering card UI elements in a React application.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: Main card container component that accepts className and other props to render a styled div.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: Component for rendering the header section of the card, with styling and data-slot attribute.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: Component for rendering the title within the card, styled as an h4 element.

methods.name: CardDescription
methods.description: Component for rendering the description or subtitle within the card.

methods.name: CardAction
methods.description: Component for rendering the action area of the card, typically for buttons or links.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: Component for rendering main content inside the card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: Component for rendering the footer area of the card.
